features.title: Ray-traced lighting
features.text: Sunlight, shadows, reflections and water, with lamps, fire and Lumas lighting the world around them.

features.title: Play at your refresh rate
features.text: Extra frames follow the game’s own motion, bringing smoother movement to 75, 120, 144, 165, 240 Hz and other displays.

features.title: A wider view
features.text: Internal resolution up to 16× and aspect ratios from 4:3 to 32:9, with sharp text and a HUD that fits your screen.

features.title: Your choice of controller
features.text: Keyboard and mouse, Xbox, PlayStation, Switch controllers, Joy-Con, Steam controllers and a real Wii Remote with Nunchuk.

features.title: Less waiting, more playing
features.text: Skip cutscenes, speed up dialogue and change settings from an in-game menu. Import Miis for your save-file icons.

features.title: Mods and texture packs
features.text: Import Riivolution mods, file replacements, Dolphin-format texture packs and HD movies from the Mods menu or by drag and drop.

features.title: 34 achievements
features.text: Track your progress with achievement pop-ups and a Luma’s board in the Comet Observatory, with goals and lifetime play stats.

features.title: Bring your save along
features.text: Import a Dolphin save, back up your progress and move saves through the launcher. Your current saves are backed up before an import.

faq: Yes. Nebula is free software under the GNU GPL v3. You need your own copy of Super Mario Galaxy; game files are not included.
Not yet. v2 is coming soon. The current public release is v1.0.1. The v2 features described here are for the upcoming update.
No. In v2, Super Mario Galaxy runs as native code built from SMGCommunity’s Petari decompilation. The original levels, music, story and gameplay come from your own game.
Which copy of the game do I need?
The supported copy is the North American Wii release, RMGE01, revision 0. For v2, prepare an ISO, RVZ or extracted folder. Support for other regions has not been announced.
Can I play on Linux, Steam Deck, Android or Mac?
Windows is available now, and an Android beta is released. Linux and SteamOS are in development; macOS is planned.
Can I use a Dolphin save?
Yes. Close the game, then use Advanced → Import saves in the launcher. See the save guide for the steps.
No. File replacements and compatible texture packs work, but mods that patch the Wii’s machine code may not run in a native game. Check the mod guide before importing.

errors: NEB-C01
The game's code crashed, with no mod changing the game.
Start again; if it repeats at the same place, report it with the report file.
NEB-C02
The game stopped itself with an error (its own fatal check); the report quotes its message.
As C01.
NEB-C03
The game's code ran out of stack space.
As C01.
NEB-M01
The game crashed while mods changed its files or code; the report lists them.
Turn the mods off and play again; if it no longer happens, turn them on one at a time.
NEB-M02
The game crashed within 15 seconds of reading a file a mod supplies; the report names the mod and the file.
Turn that mod off, or check it is made for this game's region and version.
NEB-T01
A texture pack image stopped Nebula while it loaded; the report names the file.
Remove the image from the pack or save it again as a PNG.
NEB-V01
A replacement movie stopped Nebula while it played; the report names the file.
Remove the video or convert it to an H.264 MP4.
NEB-G01
The graphics driver reset the graphics card (device removed, hung or lost).
Update the driver; turn off ray tracing and frame generation or lower the internal resolution.
NEB-G02
The renderer stopped on another error; the report quotes it.
Update the driver; report it if it repeats.
NEB-R01
Nebula ran out of memory.
Close other programs, set texture packs to On instead of Preload, or lower the internal resolution.
NEB-N01
Nebula's own code crashed (not the game's).
Start again; report it if it repeats.
NEB-N02
Nebula stopped on an unexpected error; the report quotes it.
As N01.
NEB-N03
Nebula stopped itself (abort).
As N01.
NEB-N04
Nebula stopped on an internal error while starting.
As N01.
NEB-S01
The game content (`game.pak`) was not found or could not be opened.
Run Nebula Setup again, or choose the content in Nebula settings > Advanced.
NEB-S02
The game content is damaged.
Run Nebula Setup again to rebuild it from your disc image.
NEB-S03
Nebula's files do not match each other.
Install or update Nebula again.
NEB-S04
The graphics card could not start the game.
Update the driver; with two graphics cards, choose the other in Nebula settings > Display.
NEB-S05
Nebula's settings file could not be read.
Rename `config.ini` in Nebula's settings folder to start with default settings.
NEB-S06
Nebula was started with options it does not know.
Start Nebula from its launcher or shortcut.
